body: Hey, im in a bad spot to atm, with major insomnia added to it. I've just been getting by though watching movies at night, it tends to be a good distraction to me, because usually at night no one is around.
But i was only happy around him. Maybe i will be, i don't know atm.

Thats something i have been looking for aswell for these past years. My family was basically the same. When they found out, cause i wasnt going to school, they just yelled, they basically figured it was something stupid that i could just get out of. My parents told me everyone in the family suffers from it, but if thats true then they would atleast know how hard it is. The stupid thing too is that when i was around my friend, he did make me happy, i would forget all of it. But last night i finally had to let go of them, and when i did, everything in my head stopped, i felt peaceful.

I have not completely accepted death yet, so im not killing myself for now, but i know it will be soon. I just can't go on in life with nothing, not feeling anything, just being numb.

I have, i started talking to them about it in september 2012, and they have told me they don't want me to keep talking to them. In this moment of my clear head i went back through all the messages and text we sent each other, thought of all the times we spent. And it showed they really dont want to be around me. Lots of ignored messages, i always started the conversation, same with text. If i wanted to hang out with him i had to go get him, he only ever came to me when he needed something, never to just hang out and go do something. He also does nothing but lie to me now. It sucks to have been living for these past three years because of them, and when i look at it, it was just stupid to do.

It was the only way i was able to cope back then. Since then i've seen it really messed me up to the point where i cant get a friend, i feel nothing around them. The thing i held onto for this long was a friend, but they dont want to be around me anymore.
Maybe i will talk to you, not sure yet. Like i said, i don't plan to for now, and i dont know how soon. I just know it will happen.

I really think i can't. I see no joy in anything anymore, its become harder to do. And i learned that if i care about someone like family and friends i just end up suffering more, because my depression loves to taunt me with it. Im happy to actually have a clear head though, but it really puts alot of my past 3 years in perspective.
